edges.reason: Mining mossy cobblestone walls clears the path to the crafting table placed behind them, enabling the player to access it for slab crafting
Selling 32 sticks to the fletcher villager yields 1 emerald, which is required to purchase rabbit stew from the butcher

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a mossy cobblestone wall with a pickaxe drops the mossy_cobblestone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero mossy_cobblestone_wall items, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over position-based checks because the task is fundamentally about obtaining a mined resource.

Uses inventory_has because crafting cobblestone slabs (3 cobblestone → 6 slabs) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with zero cobblestone_slab items, so having at least 6 confirms one successful craft. The player must first mine through the mossy cobblestone wall enclosure to access the crafting table inside before they can craft.

Uses inventory_has because selling 32 sticks to the fletcher villager yields 1 emerald that appears in the player's inventory. The player starts with zero emeralds, so having at least 1 confirms a successful sale. This is preferred over event-based checks because the emerald is the tangible proof of the trade completing.

Uses inventory_has because trading 1 emerald to the butcher villager yields 1 rabbit_stew that appears in the player's inventory. The player starts with zero rabbit_stew items, so having at least 1 confirms a successful purchase. This depends on first obtaining an emerald from selling sticks.

scene_description: A stone brick plaza featuring a sealed 3x3x3 mossy cobblestone wall enclosure containing a crafting table. The player must mine through the walls to access the crafting table inside. Two villagers (fletcher and butcher) stand nearby for trading. The player has sticks (for selling), cobblestone (for slab crafting), and a wooden pickaxe (for mining walls).
task_text: Mine through the mossy cobblestone wall enclosure to reach the crafting table inside and craft cobblestone slabs. Also, sell sticks to the fletcher villager to earn emeralds, then buy rabbit stew from the butcher villager.
design_notes: The enclosure is a 3x3x3 sealed cube of mossy cobblestone walls at relative coords ~3-5, ~0-2, ~4-6. The crafting table is at ~4,~0,~5 (center of the enclosure floor). The player must mine at least one wall block to enter. Fletcher at ~8,0,3 and butcher at ~10,0,3 are on the open platform. Player starts with 64 sticks (need 32 for 1 emerald), 3 cobblestone (exactly enough for 6 slabs), and a wooden pickaxe (can mine walls). The spatial dependency ensures mine→craft ordering.
